description: This Python source file provides utility functions for handling artifacts, uploading data to AWS services, and parsing test reports within the PyTorch CI/CD pipeline. It includes functions for downloading artifacts from GitHub and S3, uploading data to DynamoDB and S3, unzipping files, and checking rerun conditions for tests.

methods.name: get_s3_resource
methods.description: Returns a cached boto3 S3 resource object.

methods.name: download_s3_artifacts
methods.description: Downloads artifacts from S3 based on specified prefix, workflow run ID, attempt, and optional job ID.

methods.name: download_gha_artifacts
methods.description: Downloads artifacts from GitHub Actions based on prefix, workflow run ID, and attempt.

methods.name: upload_to_dynamodb
methods.description: Uploads a list of documents to a DynamoDB table, optionally generating partition keys.

methods.name: upload_to_s3
methods.description: Uploads a list of JSON documents to an S3 bucket with gzip compression.

methods.name: read_from_s3
methods.description: Reads and decompresses JSON documents from an S3 object.

methods.name: remove_nan_inf
methods.description: Converts NaN and infinity float values to strings for JSON serialization.

methods.name: upload_workflow_stats_to_s3
methods.description: Uploads workflow statistics to a specific S3 location.

methods.name: upload_file_to_s3
methods.description: Uploads a local file to an S3 bucket.

methods.name: unzip
methods.description: Unzips a zip file to a directory and returns the directory path.

methods.name: is_rerun_disabled_tests
methods.description: Determines if a test report is from a rerun-disabled tests workflow based on test counts and job name.

methods.name: get_job_id
methods.description: Extracts job ID from a report path.

methods.name: get_job_name
methods.description: Retrieves the job name from GitHub API based on job ID, workflow ID, and attempt.
